lines: I can get **20 l** of lactose-free milk for {{Thursday 19 Nov}}, before 13,5 % VAT. You can have the Valio Eila 10 l bag-in-box at **25,80 €**, the Arla 10 l bag-in-box at **27,40 €**, or the Valio Eila in 1 l cartons at **29,80 €**. Which one?
I've ordered **20 l** of the Valio Eila lactose-free milk for **25,80 €**. It arrives {{Thursday 19 Nov}}. Shall I email the receipt? I'd need an address.
